officialPages.title: Measure N (City of Clayton)

plainEnglish.text: Extends the Clayton Community Facilities District 2007-1 landscape parcel tax for ten years, to June 30, 2037, and raises the rate to $354.45 per residential parcel and $354.45 per non-residential acre starting July 1, 2027, with possible yearly inflation increases capped at 3%.
plainEnglish.excerpt: It proposes to extend the CFD parcel tax for ten (10) years, with a new expiration date of June 30, 2037. It also proposes to increase the annual parcel tax rate, starting July 1, 2027, to $354.45 per residential parcel and $354.45 per acre, or fraction thereof, for non-residential parcels.

yes.text: A yes vote approves the CFD parcel tax.

yes.location: City Attorney's impartial analysis, final paragraph
